features.name: Remarkable Athlete

rules.text:
Level 3: Remarkable Athlete
Thanks to your athleticism, you have Advantage on
Initiative rolls and Strength (Athletics) checks.
In addition, immediately after you score a Critical
Hit, you can move up to half your Speed without
provoking Opportunity Attacks.

revised_reference_entries: Thanks to your athleticism, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} rolls and Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) checks.

In addition, immediately after you score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB}, you can move up to half your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks}.
